page.title: Online Test
page.subtitle: Pick one answer for each question, then submit.
page.alreadyDone: You have already completed this test.
page.noTest: This position has no online test. You don't need to take one.
page.question: Q{{n}}.
page.unauthorized: Please sign in to the Candidate Portal to take the test.
page.lockedDetail: Your application must pass the CV screening round before you can take the online test.
page.antiCheatHint: Please do not leave this page while taking the test. Every tab switch or window blur is recorded and shared with the recruiter.
page.tabSwitchWarning: You have left the test {{count}} time(s). This has been recorded and will be visible to the recruiter.
page.submittedHint: Your answers have been recorded. Recruiting will let you know the outcome once this round is decided.

gate.title: Before you begin
gate.lateNotice: This {{minutes}}-minute test opened earlier and still closes at {{closes}} — you joined late, so you have less time. Start right away.
gate.leaveRule: Switching tabs, minimising the window or closing the page submits your answers as they are. Close other apps before you start.
gate.timerRule: The timer counts down to the closing time ({{closes}}) — it does not restart when you press Begin. At closing time the test submits itself.
gate.oneAttemptRule: You get ONE attempt — there is no retake.
gate.startHint: The clock keeps running while you read this page.

window.notYetTitle: The test has not opened yet
window.notYetDetail: It opens at {{time}} and closes at {{closes}} ({{minutes}} minutes). You can join any time in between, but the timer always runs to the closing time — join late and you get less time. Keep this page open; the test appears on its own when it opens.
window.closedDetail: The test ran from {{time}} to {{closes}} and has closed. Contact HR if something went wrong.
window.expiredDetail: The test ran from {{time}} to {{closes}}. You did not start it in that window, so it has expired and was submitted automatically.
window.expiredDetailNoTime: You did not start the test in the scheduled window, so it has expired and was submitted automatically.
window.expiredContact: If something prevented you from joining on time, contact HR directly — the system does not reopen the test.
